title: Section 14 SRA — Contracts not specifically enforceable

content.heading: Contracts not specifically enforceable
content.text: The following contracts cannot be specifically enforced, namely: a contract where a party has obtained substituted performance under section 20; a contract which is so dependent on the personal qualifications of the parties that the court cannot enforce specific performance of its material terms; a contract which is in its nature determinable; a contract the performance of which involves the performance of a continuous duty which the court cannot supervise.
